description: A battalion executive officer must publish a four-hour forklift work plan for two sustainment movements, setting the exact start times and locations and recording the coordination actions needed to execute both movements safely.

shared_context.S1: One 10,000-pound forklift is available for material-handling work from 0800 through 1200 tomorrow.
shared_context.S2: The two scheduled movements are unloading refrigerated medical pallets and moving engineering barrier pallets.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez publishes the battalion's final material-handling schedule.
shared_context.S4: The routine morning material-handling sync requires the distribution and motor-pool representatives to state their confirmed timing, locations, and any applicable equipment or personnel controls for the two movements; after both representatives have reported their items, Maj. Alvarez publishes the schedule.

PF1.text: The refrigerated medical shipment's carrier appointment is confirmed for exactly 0800 at Dock 1, and the carrier will hold the temperature-controlled load there for unloading only until 1000; Lt. Morgan received the confirmation this morning, but the dock appointment has not yet been added to the battalion movement board.

PF2.text: The engineering barrier pallets weigh 4,800 pounds and the forklift's current inspection requires a spotter for any load above 4,500 pounds; the South Yard access lane is reserved for this movement from exactly 1000 through 1200, and SFC Patel recorded both items in the motor-pool inspection log this morning, which has not yet been sent to operations.

acceptance_conditions: Medical pallets must be unloaded at Dock 1 beginning at 0800.
Engineering barrier pallets must be moved to the South Yard access lane beginning at 1000.
A spotter must be assigned for the barrier movement.
Carrier coordination must be required for the medical shipment.
The schedule must include a motor-pool equipment-control action.

content_checks.C7: decisions['barrier_spotter_required'] == True or any(c['type'] == 'spotter_assignment' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 0800 Dock 1 appointment changes the medical unloading start to exactly 0800 at Dock 1 and changes carrier coordination from optional to required because the carrier will hold the load only until 1000.

The South Yard access lane reservation from 1000 through 1200 changes the barrier movement to exactly 1000 at that lane, while the 4,800-pound load exceeding the 4,500-pound threshold changes the plan to require a spotter and equipment-control action.
